tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings
tool_schemas.description: Creates, updates, retrieves, lists, enables/disables optional settings for a server connection, and drives the sign-in workflow to create/list/revoke authentication sessions and list related audit events; list actions return up to `limit` items sorted by `sort` and a `next_cursor` when more results are available, using `cursor` to continue. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required identifiers are missing, do not match their patterns, the `body` contains unknown fields, or parameters are out of range (for example `limit` not in 1–200); raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not authenticated and FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot access the specified `account_id` or its servers/settings/sessions. Raises NOT_FOUND when the referenced `server_id`, `optional_settings_id`, or `session_id` does not exist under the given account; raises CONFLICT when an action is not allowed for the current state (for example enabling an already-active settings record, disabling an already-disabled record, revoking a session that is already revoked, or signing in when settings are disabled), and RATE_LIMITED when sign-in or other authenticated operations exceed configured quotas.

account_id.description: Account id that owns the optional settings.

server_id.description: Server id the settings apply to.

optional_settings_id.description: Optional settings record id to update or reference.

action.description: Operation to perform for optional settings and related authentication workflow.

body.description: Request body for create/update/sign-in and related actions.

name.description: Server display name (used when creating/updating a server alongside settings if supported).

base_url.description: Server base URL (used when creating/updating a server alongside settings if supported).

default_model.description: Default model identifier to use for requests to the server.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of automatic retries for failed requests.

verify_tls.description: Whether to verify TLS certificates when connecting to the server.

store_tokens.description: Whether to store auth tokens for re-use/refresh.

email.description: Account email used for sign-in (local auth).

password.description: Account password used for sign-in (local auth).

auth_provider.description: Authentication provider to use for sign-in.

session_id.description: Authentication session id to revoke or reference.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return for list operations.

status.description: Filter by status (varies by resource being listed).

event_type.description: Filter audit events by event type.

created_after.description: Filter records created after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

created_before.description: Filter records created before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

tool_schemas.name: Accounts
tool_schemas.description: Creates, updates, retrieves, lists, suspends/reactivates/deletes accounts. Returns account records without password material. Refuses operations that violate uniqueness (email) or attempt invalid lifecycle transitions; deleted accounts cannot be reactivated.

account_id.description: Account id to fetch/update or transition.

password.description: Account password (local auth); stored as a hash.

status.description: Account lifecycle status (use transition actions instead of setting directly when possible).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return for list operations.

created_after.description: Filter records created after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

created_before.description: Filter records created before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

tool_schemas.name: Servers
tool_schemas.description: Creates, updates, retrieves, lists, enables/disables/deletes server connections. Returns server records. Refuses duplicate base_url, and refuses invalid lifecycle transitions (deleted is terminal).

server_id.description: Server id to fetch/update or transition.

base_url.description: Server base URL; must be unique.

status.description: Server lifecycle status (use transition actions instead of setting directly when possible).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return for list operations.

created_after.description: Filter records created after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

created_before.description: Filter records created before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

tool_schemas.name: Auth Sessions
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves, lists, refreshes, and revokes authentication sessions for the authenticated account. Refresh is allowed only for active sessions and updates expires_at and last_used_at while emitting an audit event. Revocation transitions sessions to revoked and emits an audit event; revoked is terminal.

action.description: Operation to perform on auth sessions.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return for list operations.

created_after.description: Filter records created after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

created_before.description: Filter records created before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

expires_before.description: Filter sessions expiring before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

expires_after.description: Filter sessions expiring after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

tool_schemas.name: Audit Events
tool_schemas.description: Lists and fetches audit events for the authenticated account, optionally scoped to a server or session. Returns immutable audit event records. Refuses access to events not owned by the caller.

action.description: Operation to perform on audit events.

server_id.description: Filter/list audit events by server id.

session_id.description: Filter/list audit events by auth session id.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return for list operations.

created_after.description: Filter events created after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

created_before.description: Filter events created before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

tool_schemas.name: Who Am I
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated identity, its effective scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption. Refuses when authentication is missing or invalid.

action.description: Operation to perform; only 'get' is supported.

tool_schemas.name: Sign Out
tool_schemas.description: Revokes the caller’s current authentication session (or a specified session) and records an auth.session_revoked audit event. Refuses if the session is not active/owned by the caller; revoked is terminal.

session_id.description: Session id to revoke; required when action='revoke'.
